name: rss-feed-index
description: This is a simple a crawler for feeds (RSS, Atom) and OPML blogrolls.

scripts.install-www: mkdir -p /var/www/rss-feed-index/index && cp -r www/* /var/www/rss-feed-index && ln -f index/index.json /var/www/rss-feed-index/index/index.json && ln -f index/status.json /var/www/rss-feed-index/index/status.json
scripts.systemd-install: loginctl enable-linger $USER && mkdir -p ~/.config/systemd/user/ && cp rss-feed-index.service ~/.config/systemd/user/ && sed -i "s|REPLACEME_WORKDIR|$(pwd)|" ~/.config/systemd/user/rss-feed-index.service && systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user enable --now rss-feed-index.service
scripts.systemd-uninstall: systemctl --user stop rss-feed-index.service && systemctl --user disable rss-feed-index.service && rm ~/.config/systemd/user/rss-feed-index.service && systemctl --user daemon-reload
